name: WF-249 — Verified Close → Final CRM Closeout, Assignment Profit Record & Portfolio Feedback

parameters.jsCode: const d=$json.body??$json;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const close_status=String(d.close_status??d.status??"").toLowerCase();const closing_date=d.closing_date??null;const gross=Number(d.gross_profit??NaN),costs=Number(d.closing_costs??0),net=Number(d.net_profit??(Number.isFinite(gross)?gross-costs:NaN));const exit_strategy=String(d.exit_strategy??"assignment").toLowerCase();const blockers=Array.isArray(d.blockers)?d.blockers:[];let status="needs_review",reason="CRM closeout requires review.",next="WF-126";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id){status="blocked";reason="Missing lead, deal, or property identity.";}else if(blockers.length){status="blocked";reason="Unresolved closing blockers remain.";}else if(close_status!=="verified_close"){status="close_not_verified";reason="Verified close status is required.";next="WF-248";}else if(!closing_date){status="incomplete";reason="Closing date is required.";next="WF-248";}else if(!Number.isFinite(gross)||!Number.isFinite(costs)||!Number.isFinite(net)){status="profit_inputs_invalid";reason="Profit inputs are invalid.";next="WF-248";}else{status=net<0?"negative_profit_review":"closeout_ready";reason=net<0?"Verified close has negative net profit and requires review.":"Verified close is ready for CRM closeout and portfolio feedback.";next="WF-250";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-249",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,close_status,closing_date,gross_profit:Number.isFinite(gross)?gross:null,closing_costs:Number.isFinite(costs)?costs:null,net_profit:Number.isFinite(net)?net:null,exit_strategy,assignment_profit_record:{deal_id,closing_date,gross_profit:gross,closing_costs:costs,net_profit:net,exit_strategy},portfolio_feedback:{net_profit:Number.isFinite(net)?net:null,profitability_signal:net>0?"positive":net===0?"break_even":"negative"},crm_closeout_status:status,reason,requires_human_review:status!=="closeout_ready",next_workflow:next}}];
